notes.title: King's Table - The Legend Of Ragnarok Receives Update
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/54d8f3658b7cd9781908ca9a1485b3953d4107c3.jpg[/img]

Odin's blessings!

King's Table has just received an update adding new details and flavor to an already exciting and challenging game!

[list]
[*] The game’s intro sequence now plays at the start of the game.
[*] A new Quickstart Guide has been added to the game’s documentation.
[*] A new scan of the original manual has been added to the game’s documentation, which includes text in English, French, German, and Italian.
[/list]
